units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Morning. You're in Brussels. I'm Anna.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: And I'm Ben. You've got a day, and we've got fifteen minutes.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Think of it as the briefing before the mission.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Three things to know about the city.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Five things worth seeing. Three stories for your pocket.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: And one plan for when it rains.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: It's Brussels. It might rain while we're talking.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Okay. Start me off. What is this place?
